title: Red Dust Road — EN/SN/ES (Zimbabwe Family)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape Shona English Spanish language learning trilingual Zimbabwe heritage
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The red dust road runs seven kilometres from the house to the gate
Jeff has walked it every morning for forty years, never late
The ngoma starts before the sun, the hosho marks the pace
Every step a kind of prayer, every step a kind of grace

[Verse 2 — Shona (SN)]
Nzira iyi yepasi tsvuku inoenda kumba kusvika padare [This red dust road goes from house to the gate]
Jeff aifamba nzira iyi mangwanani ose [Jeff walked this road every morning]
Ngoma inoimba kabatare zino [The ngoma sings before the sun]
Hosho inoronga mafambiro [The hosho marks the rhythm of the steps]

[Chorus — English]
Red dust road
Red dust road
The mbira plays the morning in
Red dust road
Jeff and Jill and Kerri and the farm
Red dust road — still warm

[Bridge — Español]
La carretera polvorosa roja ya no existe [The red dust road is gone now]
Vendida con la granja, repavimentada [Sold with the farm, repaved]
Pero el polvo rojo vive en los zapatos de Kerri [But the red dust lives in Kerri's shoes]
Que ella guardó [That she saved]

[Verse 3 — English]
In Australia now, the kids don't know the farm
But they know something in their grandmother's arms
Red dust road — it's in the blood, it's in the song

[Outro — EN/SN/ES]
Red dust road
Nzira yepasi tsvuku [Red dust road]
Camino de polvo rojo [Red dust road]
The mbira plays on
